provenance: Ernst Neufert Architects' Data (4th International English Edition, Wiley-Blackwell, 2012) & Human Dimension and Interior Space (Panero & Zelnik, Whitney Library of Design, 1979)

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Bedrooms - Space requirements around beds (p. 254)
rules.notes: Minimum 700 mm (0.7m) clearance required on primary access sides for bed making and uninhibited access.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Bedrooms - Single beds / secondary side (p. 254)
rules.notes: Secondary side of single bed or against-wall configuration minimum clearance 550 mm.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Wardrobes and built-in cupboards (p. 256)
rules.notes: Requires minimum 900 mm front clearance to allow 500-600mm door swing plus person bending/kneeling.

rules.source_edition: 1st Edition (Whitney Library of Design / Architectural Press, 1979)
rules.notes: Sliding door wardrobes eliminate swing, requiring 750 mm for human passage and standing access.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Living Rooms - Seating arrangements (p. 251)
rules.notes: 400 mm minimum knee space between seating front and coffee table edge.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Living Rooms - Coffee table reach (p. 251)
rules.notes: Comfortable reach distance to coffee table surface is 350-450 mm.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Dining Spaces - Table arrangements and chair pull-out (p. 248)
rules.notes: Minimum 800 mm behind chair for pulling out and seating; 1000 mm for passage behind seated diner.

rules.source_section: Offices and Workplaces: Desk clearances and seating space (p. 317)
rules.notes: 900 mm minimum behind desk edge for chair rollback, seated ingress and egress.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Storage and shelving access (p. 257)
rules.notes: Minimum 700 mm front clearance to crouch or reach lower and upper shelves.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Kitchens - Work aisle dimensions (p. 244)
rules.notes: 1050 mm minimum work aisle between counter and opposite obstruction for 1 person work + oven/dishwasher drop door.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Kitchens - Kitchen island passage (p. 245)
rules.notes: 1200 mm clearance between island and opposite counter allowing two persons to pass/work simultaneously.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Bathrooms - WC compartments and frontal clearance (p. 260)
rules.notes: Minimum 600 mm in front of WC rim, 200 mm side clearance on each side of the bowl.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Bathrooms - Washbasin activity space (p. 261)
rules.notes: Minimum 700 mm in front of washbasin for bending forward when washing face.

rules.source_section: Domestic Buildings: Bathrooms - Shower tray entrance clearance (p. 262)
rules.notes: 700 mm clear landing in front of shower entry or bath rim for drying off and safe step-out.

rules.source_section: Building Components: Corridors and internal circulation (p. 182)
rules.notes: Standard single-person passage width between furniture items.

rules.source_edition: 1st Edition (Whitney Library of Design / Architectural Press, 1979)
rules.source_section: Residential Spaces: Dressing Table & Stool Clearance (p. 156)
rules.notes: 650 mm front clearance for pulling out stool or dressing table chair.

rules.source_title: Architects' Data (Ernst Neufert) & ADA Accessibility Guidelines
rules.notes: Continuous clear path of 900 mm required for accessible residential navigation.
Unverified internal guideline: Kept separate from mandatory Neufert standards. Must not be used as a hard compliance constraint.
